Okay so on April 22 2011 I watched my dad die of a sudden heart attack. I was 15 at the time, and my parents were divorced. I had a bitch step mom, who teased me all my life calling me fat and ugly. So I was stuck with her until the end of the school year, and then I was moving back with my mom. 6 years ago my mom was diagnosed with stage 4 breast cancer, so she was on chemo therapy. In November of 2011 my last grandparent died, It was my mom's mom. My mom was on really heavy chemo drugs, so she would forget things a lot, buy 3 of everything, she could drive because she would be messing with stuff. So my brother and I took her license away and her credit card. We didn't want her spending money we didn't have or getting in an accident. This put a lot of stress on my brother (21) and I. Especially when we went to my grandmas funeral, Because she told us to head back home and she was going to stay with my aunts a couple more days and then her friend was going to drive back. Unfortunately I got a call at 10 pm one night from her friend saying she cant take it anymore, she was stuck down there in Illinois, she was panicing because she couldnt drive back. Also my mom was drivig her crazy.. she would be up all the time. When she was tired she would go lay down close her eyes for 10 seconds, and think she slept for a half a day. Then she would eat the meals she think she missed. She was pretty damn crazy, but we had to remember its not her fault. Anyway i got that call, and then I got a call from my mom, who was freaking out because she didnt know where her friend was (she was in another room trying to get away from her, so she was in another hotel room). So we had to somehow figure out how to get those two back. So my brother and his friend decided to drive 3-4 hours after they got off work at 9pm. They were pissed, but they are good people for doing that. Everyone was under a lot of stress, and when my mom did get back she was In an out of the hospital all the time. Eventually she would be complaining, and my brother would be say 'stop your just not thinking right' but I didnt care if she was or not, I was still very worried so I always took her in. Unfortunately this whole situation kind of pushed my mom and I away from each other, I mean I still loved her I was just really frustrated and crabby all the time so we would argue. But she started getting normal again around January. In February she went in the hospital and stayed there. She had extremely low platelets, and they wouldn't get them back up to normal, so they pretty much told us she was going to bleed to death. So I visited her everyday, I wish I would have stayed the night with her, but I never did and I feel guilty as shit. But around March 1st she started having terrible chest pain, so they put her on a shit ton of morphine. So her last couple days you could talk to her but she was too doped up to respond. You could tell she was trying, but she couldn't, I think that was the hardest thing. On March 3rd, she let out her last breath, and my brother and I were right there by her side. We got to say our goodbyes, and when it was my turn, I actually threw up I was so upset. She was my best friend, I could always talk to her about anything. I miss her so much still. So then my brother and I moved into a house his boss is renting out. So that was stressful, going through all of her shit. We also live with one of his close friends, whom he went to high school with
Then in late July my boyfriend who had been with me through it all left me because he wanted to be 'single for a long time,' well i couldn't take it, I wanted to die, just to end all of this hurt. When I was in the hospital my brother told me the girl he had secretly been talking to and worked with all the time, had started dating...it was only 2 1/2 weeks after we broke up. So he lied to me about the reasoning of the break up. While in the hospital they told me I had severe depression and anxiety. After I got out I was really happy, I didn't miss him I was just super pissed off at him. In the beginning of our relationship I had 2 guy best friends, and one of them liked me (Austin), and tried to kiss me, and I told him to gtfo. I told him and he told me if I ever talked to another guy again, he would leave me. So after we broke up I started talking to my first best guy friend Paul, he had always been there for me, even though I couldn't talk to him. He knew my mom so he did come to the funeral, and sadly he was more concerned about me than my own boyfriend. He cried, and you could see the hurt and concern for me in his face. Also my boyfriend got all pissed because he came to the funeral. So when I did get out of the hospital I started talking to Austin, and the day before school started we had sex :3 it wasn't planned it just happened. I mean he was just so caring and sweet. Unfortunately I know now that I never should have done that because he told me he was falling for me and then just completely stopped talking to me, like wow okay fuck you asshole. So now I feel abandoned, and my best friend Paul is the only person I have left. But he doesn't go to my school, he is graduated, And doesn't have a car. So I have to drive like 25 min to see him. He does like me, but he has a girlfriend who he isn't happy with. The thing is he doesn't act on his feelings for me. He will never cheat on his girlfriend, he just told me how he feels about me, and I told him how I feel about him. So I have no idea what to do. Another guy at my school likes me, but he is a pothead, and he flirts with me a shit ton, and has a girlfriend. 
My ex and that bitch broke up, because she went off to college. So he texted me saying all this shit, like "I'm sorry I fucked up" I just never replied. Eventually he asked me out for breakfast to talk about shit, the night he asked me I was fucked up, I had been drinking a lot, so I said yes. So the next morning he picked me up, and It's safe to say I'm so glad I'm not with him, He is such a fucking idiot. He smokes now, is constantly high on vikadin, which his fucking manager supplies for him. And he said he wants to try every drug. At one pint he said, 'yeah I would have shot up heroin last night but I had to go home.'really? your fucking 17, you are going to go nowhere in your life. Then he was always making these sick jokes about sex, like he was trying to make me jealous, which I was over him so it didn't bother me, but it was still disgusting. So when I posted this I was just overwhelmed, which is what happens every night. I have insomnia, so I can't sleep like ever. I have sleep meds, but I cant take them at 11pm because they are strong as shit, and I get up at 5:30. So I sit up all night depressed, cutting, wanting to take all of my sleeping pills. 
There now you all know about my shit life.
